description: Baile & Vibes continues VHOOR’s “Baile” series, previously releasing “Baile & Beats” and “Baile & Trill.” The series is VHOOR’s take on Brazilian Baile Funk, incorporating the distinctly Brazilian movement with other Afro-Latin rhythms, Hip-Hop, Footwork, Trap, Grime, Chill Wave and other global sounds.
